facts.title: Butternut Squash Mac and Cheese
ingredients: 1 medium to large butternut squash (1.5 pounds or larger), halved
1 pound short-cut pasta (pipe regate, macaroni noodles, casarecce, cavatelli, fusilli)
½ cup (2 ounces) finely grated Parmesan cheese, plus more for serving
facts.author: Cookie and Kate
